claims.text: ERCOT's preliminary summary of the Data Center State and Community Impact RFI was prepared for the PUC Open Meeting of November 5th, 2026, and its title slide names Chad V. Seely, Senior Vice President, Regulatory Policy, General Counsel, and Chief Compliance Officer.
claims.quote: Chad V. Seely Senior Vice President, Regulatory Policy, General Counsel, and Chief Compliance Officer PUC Open Meeting November 5, 2026

claims.text: Every data slide in ERCOT's Community Impact RFI summary is marked preliminary as of November 5th and subject to change.
claims.quote: PRELIMINARY AS OF 11/5, SUBJECT TO CHANGE

claims.text: ERCOT's preliminary summary says it issued the Data Center State and Community Impact RFI to 465 loads.
claims.quote: ERCOT issued the Data Center State and Community Impact Request for Information (RFI) to 465 loads.

claims.text: Preliminary figures show 433 of 465 loads (93%) submitted the RFI, covering about 177 GW (about 97%) of requested interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: 433 of 465 loads (93%) submitted the RFI, covering ~177 GW (~97%) of requested interconnection capacity.

claims.text: In the preliminary count, 417 RFIs were submitted on time and 16 were submitted late. Most were due at 5pm CT on October 12th.
claims.quote: 417 RFIs were submitted on time (most due 5pm CT on 10/12), and 16 were submitted late.

claims.text: As of the preliminary summary, 32 Medium Load responses had not been submitted.
claims.quote: 32 Medium Load responses have not been submitted.

claims.text: ERCOT's preliminary summary says all 245 Large Loads, those of 75 MW or greater, responded to the RFI.
claims.quote: All 245 Large Loads (75 MW or greater) responded to the RFI.

claims.text: Preliminary figures show Large Loads represent about 94% of requested interconnection capacity, about 166 GW.
claims.quote: Large Loads represent ~94% of requested interconnection capacity (~166 GW).

claims.text: Among Large Loads, 33 projects are requesting interconnections greater than 1 GW. In the preliminary figures they represent 36% of capacity.
claims.quote: Among Large Loads, 33 projects representing 36% of capacity are requesting interconnections greater than 1 GW.

claims.text: Preliminary data show requests in every ERCOT Load Zone. West Texas represents the plurality with 41% of capacity, 73 GW.
claims.quote: Requests span every ERCOT Load Zone; West Texas represents the plurality with 41% of capacity (73 GW).

claims.text: The preliminary West load zone figure is 88 Large Loads, 39 Medium Loads and 73 GW of peak interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: 88 LL · 39 ML · 73 GW

claims.text: The preliminary North load zone figure is 69 Large Loads, 85 Medium Loads and 45 GW of peak interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: 69 LL · 85 ML · 45 GW

claims.text: The preliminary South load zone figure is 72 Large Loads, 38 Medium Loads and 49 GW of peak interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: 72 LL · 38 ML · 49 GW

claims.text: The preliminary Houston load zone figure is 14 Large Loads, 24 Medium Loads and 10 GW of peak interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: 14 LL · 24 ML · 10 GW

claims.text: The preliminary load zone breakdown counts 429 included loads, 243 Large Loads and 186 Medium Loads, with 37 near a zone boundary. A load's actual zone is set at interconnection and may differ.
claims.quote: Actual assigned Load Zone is set at interconnection and may differ. N = 429 included loads (243 LL, 186 ML), 37 near a zone boundary;

claims.text: The preliminary load zone breakdown leaves out Non-Opt-In Entity load zones.
claims.quote: Does not include Non-Opt-In Entity (NOIE) Load Zones

claims.text: According to the preliminary summary, respondents answered 83% of the nearly 67,000 RFI questions.
claims.quote: Respondents answered 83% of the nearly 67,000 RFI questions

claims.text: In the preliminary summary, cooling questions had the largest fraction left unanswered, the highest N/A rate of any category. Respondents said many projects had not determined their final cooling configuration.
claims.quote: The largest fraction of not answered questions were related to cooling, where respondents indicated that many projects had not determined their final cooling configuration.

claims.text: Preliminary figures put the N/A answer rate slightly lower among Large Loads, about 16%, than among Medium Loads, about 19%.
claims.quote: The rate of N/A answers was slightly lower among Large Loads (~16%) than Medium Loads (~19%).

claims.text: In the preliminary summary, projects with requested energization dates of 2028 or later answered N/A 30% more frequently than projects due earlier.
claims.quote: Projects with 2028+ requested energization dates responded ‘N/A’ to questions 30% more frequently than pre-2028

claims.text: Preliminary figures show about 95% of facilities will not conduct any virtual currency mining. They represent more than 99% (175.9 GW) of total requested interconnection capacity.
claims.quote: ~95% of facilities will not conduct any virtual currency mining activities, representing >99% (175.9 GW) of the total requested interconnection capacity.

claims.text: In the preliminary summary, 22 facilities report virtual currency mining as a full or partial facility function. Nearly all of them (20) are Medium Loads requesting less than 75 MW.
claims.quote: Of the 22 facilities reporting virtual currency mining as a full or partial facility function, nearly all (20) are Medium Loads requesting <75 MW.

claims.text: ERCOT says detailed analysis of the RFI is underway and that it is targeting a published final report on December 10th, 2026.
claims.quote: Detailed data analysis is currently underway, and ERCOT is targeting a published final report on December 10, 2026.

claims.text: In the separate Batch Zero Eligibility Verification process, groups within ERCOT and outside legal counsel reviewed first round responses from 257 developers, approximately 5,140 questions.
claims.quote: Several groups within ERCOT, as well as outside legal counsel, have reviewed the responses from 257 developers, approximately 5,140 questions.

claims.text: ERCOT is issuing second RFIs in the Batch Zero Eligibility Verification process and expects to send them to 80% of developers.
claims.quote: ERCOT expects to send RFIs to 80% of the developers.

claims.text: The second round verification RFIs give developers a reasonable opportunity to explain any deficiencies, with a 5 Business Day deadline.
claims.quote: the second round RFIs provide developers a “reasonable opportunity” to explain any deficiencies. 5 Business Day deadline.

claims.text: As of its November 5th, 2026 update, ERCOT said it had to complete its verification review that month to file a report with the PUCT on December 10th, 2026.
claims.quote: ERCOT must complete its review this month to file a report with the PUCT on December 10, 2026.

claims.text: ERCOT had not completed its verification review. One common issue emerging was a lack of documentation to establish affiliate relationships.
claims.quote: Lack of documentation to establish affiliate relationships

claims.text: Another common issue emerging in ERCOT's unfinished verification review was an inability to demonstrate site control.
claims.quote: Inability to demonstrate site control

claims.text: Another common issue emerging in ERCOT's unfinished verification review was an inability to establish that long-lead time equipment was ordered and will be delivered before energization.
claims.quote: Inability to establish long-lead time equipment ordered and will be delivered before energization

claims.text: Another common issue emerging in ERCOT's unfinished verification review was difficulty confirming the amount of financial security posted.
claims.quote: Difficulty confirming the amount of financial security posted

claims.text: ERCOT's market notice M-B091426-01 is dated September 14th, 2026.
claims.quote: NOTICE DATE: September 14, 2026

claims.text: The September 14th, 2026 market notice was addressed to developers of data centers of 25 MW and larger, transmission and distribution service providers, and market participants.
claims.quote: Developers of Data Centers 25 MW and Larger

claims.text: The market notice set a response deadline of no later than 5 p.m. Central Prevailing Time on October 12th, 2026.
claims.quote: 5 p.m. Central Prevailing Time (CPT) on October 12, 2026

claims.text: The market notice warned that failure to respond to the RFI or any part of it will be reported to the PUC and the Office of the Governor.
claims.quote: Failure to respond to the RFI or any part thereof will be reported to the PUC and the Office of the Governor.

claims.text: The Executive Administrator of the TWDB authorized ERCOT to issue the RFI's Section C questions on the TWDB's behalf.
claims.quote: The Executive Administrator of the TWDB has authorized ERCOT to issue the questions in Section C on TWDB

claims.text: In the September 14th, 2026 notice, ERCOT said it expected to publish the report no later than December 10th, 2026.
claims.quote: ERCOT expects to publish this report no later than December 10, 2026

claims.text: The utility commission's calendar lists an open meeting on Thursday, December 17th, 2026.
claims.quote: Open Meeting - Thursday, December 17, 2026
